A big advantage of this restaurant is that you can taste beer that is difficult to find in regular beer bars, and I liked being able to enjoy the unique aroma, taste, and texture. However, since it is Gangnam Station, beer prices are not low, and some maniac beers are quite expensive, so please keep in mind. reviews.text:
Cloud chicken and beer were very delicious. But to put it bluntly, the service was very poor.
As we finished eating the food and drinks we ordered, our group sat down together. It was an hour before closing, and the group put their coats and bags on chairs at the next table where there were no customers. If other guests were unable to sit there or were displeased due to the luggage, it would be our table's fault, but I don't remember such a situation ever happening. However, the staff member came and without saying anything other than 'Put this here...' he picked up the coat and bag and handed them to the group. I think I would have taken it on my own if I had just said that I had to leave it for another guest... but as soon as that situation happened, I felt so uncomfortable and bad that I immediately got up. I wasn't expecting high quality service at a high price, but I was very disappointed because it seemed to be below the standard level. It's a level I don't want to visit again.

reviews.author: Kim Sang-yeop
reviews.text:
I went to Sidevine Cinema in Gangnam and the atmosphere was better than I expected.

Once you enter, there are a lot of movie posters and film reels, so it feels like a small movie theater. It doesn't feel like it's been overly decorated just because it's a concept bar, but it feels like a space created by people who like movies. The lighting is dim so it's good for drinking.

There are quite a few cocktails on the menu that are named after movies or are based on movies, so it's fun to find them. I thought the taste of the drink would be mediocre because of the concept, but it was better than I expected. It wasn't too sweet and was easy to drink.

Many bars in Gangnam are too noisy or crowded, but here it's not that loud, so it's easy to have a conversation. It would be nice to come on a date or as a second party with a friend.

The downside is that the space is not that large, so it can be a bit crowded if there are a lot of people. Still, if you are looking for a bar with a slightly different atmosphere in Gangnam, this is a place worth checking out.

The menu is a 3-person snack set featuring tantan mara hot pot, cheese bacon potato pancake, and octopus capellini, and I recommend iced hongsi for dessert! reviews.author: Sooyeon Ahn
reviews.text:
At the end of a quiet alley, when you open the wooden door, you will find ‘ZAC’, a traditional liquor bar with bottles lined up under soft lighting.
It's not flashy, but it's a neat and sophisticated space. The deep scent of traditionalism spreads like the air.

The owner personally explains the background and aroma of the drink, making it an ‘experience’ rather than just a drink.
You can try a variety of traditional liquors with a glass of alcohol, making it a fun place for beginners and a fun place for experts as well.

The music is soothing and the lighting is warm.
Recommended for nights when you want to enjoy the scent rather than conversation, or for those who want to stay quietly alone.

The price is a little high, but you can feel the quality.
There are few bars with this level of calm and authenticity in the heart of Gangnam, Seoul.

📍 Written by Korean Sul Bar (ZAC)

The staff were friendly and the food came out at a reasonable rate, but you may need to call multiple times during peak times. The interior was simple and bright, and the tables and chairs were spaced appropriately so it didn't feel crowded. The price was reasonable and the portions were generous, so even though two people ordered three dishes, they couldn't eat them all. The downside is that the location is a bit disappointing. It's a little difficult to find because it's inside an alley. It would be a good idea to install the signboard more prominently. Overall, it's a place worth visiting at least once, especially for a family gathering, and I'll be visiting with friends next time.

reviews.author: Yoo Chang-hee
reviews.text: The playground where young children can play has a soft floor and is equipped with equipment for simple stretching and bodyweight exercises, as well as benches to sit and rest leisurely. Although it is not large in size, a small number of people can rest or walk around comfortably. I think it would be nice to just take a walk with your pet! Instead, it would be a good idea to prepare a pet waste bag and leash!

reviews.author: digital world
reviews.text: There are a lot of tall trees and bushes that look like something out of Jurassic Park, a senior center and a rest area with a transparent acrylic roof. There are a lot of office workers at lunchtime, a lot of children in the afternoon, people exercising in the evening, and dogs.

display_name: The Smurf Magic Forest Gangnam Branch

reviews.author: Kim forgot
reviews.text: You can't think of it as a regular room escape; you go into the Smurfs' house, solve problems, read the story, and come out. It's okay to go there at least once until you reach the lower grades of elementary school.

reviews.author: Nororo
reviews.text: I went there with my 1st grade child. But it's not that easy. Adults need to think about it too to solve the problem. Since the hints are unlimited, if you give your child a chance, sometimes he or she will come up with more ingenious solutions. The content is sound, so I think it would be good for your first escape room experience. This is not an escape room where you move from room to room, but a way to solve problems using media art. I will go again when the next season comes out in the first half of next year!!

reviews.author: titi
reviews.text: It was my first escape room(?) and it was so much fun that I’m waiting for part 2… I went with a friend who enjoys escape rooms, and we both had a lot of fun because it was a new escape room experience! When part 2 comes out, I'll make a reservation and go again 💙

reviews.author: Jiwoo Jiwoo (National Jiwoo Graphics)
reviews.text: It's a new room escape (though it's not an escape), and it's refreshing that it uses Smurfs under an official license. Would it be okay to say that it feels like an online game brought to life? I would like to recommend it to people around me, but the only drawback is that the price is a bit high. Considering the location and the price of the existing escape rooms, it is understandable. The boss said that since all the money was spent making part 1, we need to save up money to make part 2. Even though it is a bit expensive, I am willing to do a part 2, so I am posting a review.

reviews.author: Soohyun Jeong

I'm so excited for the next episode!

reviews.author: Seonggyeongrim
reviews.text: It may be difficult to find as it is located on the connecting road between Gangnam Station and Shinbundang. It's located on the 3rd floor of the basement of the station, and it's a gallery cafe, so it's a quiet space where you can drink tea while appreciating wonderful works of art.  I also once used it as a study meeting place. By the way, parking is not allowed.

reviews.author: Peter Lee
reviews.text:
Gallery Cafe G Arche located in Gangnam Station, Seoul!

Located in Gangnam Station as an art and culture complex space.
The fact that it is so accessible is also great!

In addition, there is a separate rental space for various meetings, seminars, etc., and the best thing is that there are not many people.
It is possible to have a leisurely conversation over a cup of coffee!

Friendly service from handsome clerks is a bonus!
Art exhibitions are also often held, so be on time.
It would be nice to relax and enjoy the work of art to your heart’s content!

If you have work or a meeting at Gangnam Station
Be sure to stop by at least once and enjoy all the leisure and relaxation!

reviews.author: KRY
reviews.text: This is a gallery cafe where works of art such as sculptures and paintings are displayed. I often visit when I want to have a quiet conversation at Gangnam Station, and the drink menu has become more diverse since the new barista arrived, which is even better.
